svg.title: GCP Security Monitoring and Incident Response Architecture
svg.desc: Shows how threats flow from the internet through GCP Security Command Center, triggering automated responses via Pub/Sub and Cloud Functions

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What kind of threats come from the internet in this project?')
sendPrompt('How is the VPC configured in this project?')
sendPrompt('How is least privilege IAM implemented?')
sendPrompt('What does GCP Security Command Center detect?')
sendPrompt('What does Cloud Armor protect against?')
sendPrompt('How does Pub/Sub work in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the Cloud Function do to respond to threats?')
sendPrompt('What goes in the GitHub README for this project?')
